messages.author: c102ef7f5617067f
messages.subject: Erase unwanted sound
parts:
Hello,

I have lots of wav files containing bird calls. Some of the recordings have lots of unwanted noise at various frequencies. What are the best ways of erasing the unwanted noise whilst keeping the bird calls?

Many thanks
Ross

messages.author: bfa183f4897a5619
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Erase unwanted sound
parts:
Hi Ross,

A common strategy is to use the ffilter() function, which can be used as a high-pass (e.g. getting rid of traffic noise), low-pass (e.g. getting rid of high-pitched insect noise), or bandstop filter (e.g. if you had an annoying narrowband noise in the same frequency range as your calls of interest, you could chop it out and still retain some of the signal of interest).

best,
jesse
